line: Building a general dishwasher-loading manipulation policy in NVIDIA Isaac Lab; released the simulated dish assets.
Built the 12 subtask environments and asset pipeline for the Fiatlux benchmark, and the force-monitored expert and imitation-learning pipeline for the AI for Industry Challenge.
RAG pipeline for text-to-SQL with self-consistency decoding; migrated to an open-source model while keeping 80% execution accuracy.
Isabelle/HOL proofs of functional correctness, following the seL4 and RT-11 verification efforts.
Efficient simulation of a biological reaction model, with 2D and 3D visualization of the results.
